products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company, traded as WDAY, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2026-01-31, reports revenue of $9,552,000,000. The company's site presents it as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, and describes a way of working with Sana and agentic AI from Workday.

The product tracked for Workday is Workday AI, described as HR and finance AI with skills-based talent features and predictive analytics, and noted for sensitive HR data exposure. Workday says its AI lets customers activate teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across HR, finance, and IT, and that these agents can find, build, act, and automate rather than only assist. The company also says this work is driven by trust, agility, and data readiness.

The record also lists federal cases naming Workday in the District Court for the Eastern District of California, the Northern District of Georgia, the Northern District of California, the District of Colorado, the District of Maryland, and the Eastern District of Virginia, including Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc., Williams v. Workday, Inc., Elias v. Workday, Inc., Noriega (PS) v. Workday, Inc., Hill v. Workday, Inc., and Doe (PS) v. Workday, Inc. A separate count places 270 cases in California.
